svg.title: The hand stops above the contested inference
svg.desc: Freeze the hand over the keyboard and retain the original recurrence circle. The newly drawn through-wipe line belongs to the contested explanatory sketch, never to a confirmed cache-transfer diagram.

The newly drawn through-wipe line belongs to the contested explanatory sketch, never to a confirmed cache-transfer diagram.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "hand", "box": [ 0.144712, 0.2012, 0.237377, 0.4189 ], "color": "dirty", "focus": true }, { "asset": "paper", "box": [ 0.52275, 0.2012, 0.3913, 0.276474 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "RECURRENCE", "label_box": [ 0.52275, 0.49443, 0.3913, 0.121481 ], "label_size": 18 } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "row", "source": "
**Frame:** Curt's hand stops over the keyboard. On the legal pad, the heavy circle he drew around the recurrence on [page 038](038.md) is still there. He does not erase it. He draws a second line *through* the wipe — the one line the chapter has spent eleven pages insisting could not be drawn.

**Dialogue — CURT:**
> No. He's right. There was a channel and I drew the wrong one.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` + `disputed` — Curt's concession is invented; the underlying conflict between `OAI-BH` and `METR` is real and is not resolved here or later.

", "title": "The hand stops above the contested inference" } }
